items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Uh-huh. And you did the Lena Horne >> [(prose)] special and the Carol Burnett show for Mel Torme and Carol Burnett. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: Oh, there was a team that worked on the
Carol Burnett Show that wrote a quartet for Sarah Vaughan, Peggy Lee and Aretha Franklin and -- I forget the fourth singer. It's a name.
Peggy Lee, Sarah Vaughan, Aretha Franklin -- Roberta Flack.
